name: webext-notionish
description: Restyles Google Docs and Sheets to read like Notion, hiding the chrome around the document.
author: kud

scripts.probe:selectors: pbcopy < tools/selector-probe.js && echo 'selector probe copied — page console (Cmd+Opt+K), Cmd+V, Enter'
scripts.probe:spacing: pbcopy < tools/spacing-probe.js && echo 'spacing probe copied — page console (Cmd+Opt+K), Cmd+V, Enter'
scripts.probe:model: pbcopy < tools/model-probe.js && echo 'model probe copied — page console (Cmd+Opt+K), Cmd+V, Enter'
scripts.probe:title: pbcopy < tools/title-query.js && echo 'title query copied — paste, then click into the document title'
scripts.probe:header: pbcopy < tools/header-probe.js && echo 'header probe copied — page console (Cmd+Opt+K), Cmd+V, Enter'
